LESSON: VIRTUES AND PRINCIPLES OF DHARMA IN BUDDHISM (BASED ON SCRIPTURAL STORIES)

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: General
Strand: Principles of Dharma
Topic 7.1: Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories). Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)
2. Practise Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) in the examples.
2. Explain Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories).
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)
2. Practise Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories) at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Virtues and Principles of Dharma in Buddhism (based on Scriptural stories)

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
